patch_description: This edit implements a "Dynamic Tapered Budget Splitting" strategy. Instead of a fixed 92/8 split, the split starts more aggressively (96/4) to build a massive initial spine and then tapers down to 80/20 as the budget depletes. This ensures that argument branches have enough "residual fuel" to generate variables or small sub-terms rather than just literals, improving variable reuse. Additionally, it introduces a frequency-weighted context selection to further bias towards types that are already heavily populated in the environment.
